parameter_semantics: drawer_origin_world_m is the current world-frame origin in metres of the drawer at drawer_position=0. drawer_orientation_wxyz is its unit wxyz orientation and defines local -X opening translation. desired_open_position_m is the intended scalar opening in metres, bound to the demonstrated 0.300 m. Fresh drawer_position and measured robot/object state come from the executor.
output_semantics: Each slot is an absolute TCP target expressed in the drawer frame computed at that slot's pre-action observation: relative position [3] in metres, relative rotation as the first two rotation-matrix columns [6], then native gripper scalar [1]. At execution, slots 1..8 correspond to current t..t+7. Every slot is transformed through the drawer frame recomputed from the fresh current drawer_position and caller calibration. Rotation 6D is projected by Gram-Schmidt, then the world target is passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. The gripper scalar is appended unchanged and the common executor maps its sign to open/close.

conversion_check.description: For valid labels, drawer-frame encode/decode reconstructs the demonstrated commanded world TCP pose; shared IK is checked by FK position/rotation and the unchanged gripper scalar. Gram-Schmidt only projects sampled non-orthogonal 6D rotations.

cut_relation: Covers every assigned action in each [0,470) segment. It retains approach, front acquisition, pull, release, retreat, red approach/closure and initial lift, including the full action-supervised 230:470 overlap with red_transfer.
